title: Sharing tables backed by default storage will be enabled by default for all accounts
body:
OpenSharing support for tables backed by [default storage](/aws/en/storage/default-storage) is generally available and on by default for most accounts. For most Enterprise or Premium tier accounts, Databricks will enable it automatically in mid-September 2026, and by early 2027 for the rest.

Until it is enabled for your account, an account admin can turn on the **OpenSharing for Default Storage – Expanded Access** feature from the **Previews** page in the account console. See [Manage Databricks previews](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews).
